comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Marine Terrace MRT about 460 m, Marine Parade MRT about 700 m; closer than 300 of 462 similar developments (the same as 9). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest CHIJ (Katong) Primary about 500 m; more than 340 of 462 similar developments (the same as 68). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 590 m), more than 56 of 462 similar developments (the same as 149); nearest hawker centre Marine Terrace about 640 m; nearest park Telok Kurau Park about 480 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (K Suites, 6 new sales, about 580 m; Straits at Joo Chiat, 3 new sales, about 680 m; Claydence, 8 new sales, about 780 m; Koon Seng House, 6 new sales, about 930 m; Verdé Joo Chiat, 9 new sales, about 1,210 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,570 m; Amber House, 31 new sales, about 1,690 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 1,760 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 390 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 297 new sales and 939 resales (1,236 purchases); new sales were 24% of these purchases. Subsales (19) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 939 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 415 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 939 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,019 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−7.9%). Planning-area private resales −7.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
